questions.question: Paul called Onesimus his child in his letter to Philemon. When did Paul become like a father to Onesimus?

answers.text: While he was out at sea

questions.question: In Paul's letter to Philemon, how did Paul say Onesimus had changed?

answers.text: He was useless but became useful
He was sick but became healthy
He was poor but became wealthy

questions.question: Paul asked Philemon to welcome Onesimus back, no longer as a slave but as what?
If Onesimus had wronged Philemon or owed him anything, what did Paul tell Philemon to do?

answers.text: Ask the church to pay it
